h+ya ghṛ wa'i rjes rim skabs su mchod bstod nongs bshags mdor bsdus spro na/oṃ pad+man+ta kṛta dhe wa gha ṇa badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/

tei:div.tei:p: )h+ya ghṛ wa'i rjes rim skabs su mchod bstod nongs bshags mdor bsdus spro na/ oṃ pad+man+ta kṛta dhe wa gha ṇa badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ ma hā pañtsa rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung mchog pad+ma'i rigs// chos sku 'od dpag med pa rdo rje'i chos// spyan ras gzigs dbang hrīḥlas dbang chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod// hrīḥ dbang chen lha tshogs thugs dang ci 'gal ba// mthol lo bshags so byang dag tshangs par bcol// badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe aḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ: mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku rta mchog dpal: tshangs pa'i chos sgras khams gsum dbang du sdud: mi rtog mi dmigs mnyam nyid chos kyi sku: bla med sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: kā ya sid+dhi oṃḥ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ dngos grub blangs/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ bsngo smon gshegs bsdu bkra shis sogs kyis mthar dbyung ngo*/ zhes pa'ang mos ldan tshe dpag gis bskul ngor/ stag sprul pas bgyis pa'o/// /
